insights.summary: Invoca offline call conversions reach Google Ads one to three days after the call, so Smart Bidding optimizes on incomplete data.
insights.quote: When a call comes in and it's a booked job, that conversion gets into Google Ads late. Like one to three days late.

insights.summary: Customer links "offline conversions lag in google ads" to the renewal decision.
insights.quote: We're spending real money on Smart Bidding and if the data's arriving late, I'm paying for decisions built on half the picture.
